# Drawer (`drawer`)

Side panel from the left or right.

Group: Overlays. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/overlays';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createDrawer` (types in `dist/web/overlays/drawer.d.ts`): `.mh-overlay.mh-drawer.mh-drawer--left | --right`: a modal side panel the full height of the screen. Parts: `__panel`, `__header`, `__title`, `__close`, `__body`, `__footer`.

```ts
export function createDrawer(options: DrawerOptions = {}): DrawerHandle;

export interface DrawerOptions extends OverlayBaseOptions {
  /** Default `right`. */
  side?: DrawerSide;
  description?: string;
}

export type DrawerHandle = OverlayHandle;

export interface OverlayBaseOptions {
  /** Visible title; also the accessible name. */
  title?: string;
  /** Accessible name when there's no visible title. */
  label?: string;
  /** A close button in the header. Default true. */
  closeButton?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name of the close button. Default "Close". */
  closeLabel?: string;
  /** Escape and a scrim click close it. Default true. */
  dismissible?: boolean;
  /** Portals into the nearest `[data-mh-theme]` ancestor of this element (default `document.body`). */
  container?: HTMLElement | null;
  /** Body content. */
  content?: Child | Child[];
  /** Footer content (usually buttons); the footer is hidden when empty. */
  footer?: Child | Child[];
  /** Called on every close, with what closed it (`'api'` for `close()`). */
  onClose?: (reason: OverlayCloseReason) => void;
  onOpen?: () => void;
}

export interface OverlayHandle {
  /** The `<dialog>` root. */
  el: HTMLDialogElement;
  panel: HTMLElement;
  body: HTMLElement;
  footer: HTMLElement;
  open(): void;
  close(): void;
  isOpen(): boolean;
  setTitle(title: string): void;
  setContent(...children: Child[]): void;
  setFooter(...children: Child[]): void;
  /** Closes immediately and detaches. */
  destroy(): void;
}
```

`h` (types in `dist/web/dom.d.ts`): Creates an element: string and number attributes are set, `true` sets an empty attribute, `on*` functions become listeners.

```ts
export function h<K extends keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap>(tag: K, attrs: Attrs = {}, ...children: Child[]): HTMLElementTagNameMap[K];
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createDrawer, h } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const rooms = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Bedroom', 'Garden'];

const drawer = createDrawer({
  side: 'left',
  title: 'Rooms',
  content: h(
    'nav',
    { 'aria-label': 'Rooms' },
    ...rooms.map((room) => h('p', {}, h('a', { href: `#${room.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')}` }, room))),
  ),
});
// Following a link closes the drawer.
drawer.body.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
  if ((event.target as Element).closest('a')) drawer.close();
});

const open = createButton({ label: 'Rooms', icon: 'menu', variant: 'secondary', onClick: () => drawer.open() });

document.body.append(open.el);
```

`Drawer` (types in `dist/react/overlays.d.ts`): `createDrawer` as a component.

```ts
export function Drawer({ side = 'right', ...props }: DrawerProps);

export interface DrawerProps extends OverlayProps {

}

  open: boolean;

}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Drawer } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const rooms = ['Living room', 'Kitchen', 'Bedroom', 'Garden'];

export function DrawerExample() {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <Button icon="menu" variant="secondary" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Rooms
      </Button>
      <Drawer open={open} onClose={() => setOpen(false)} side="left" title="Rooms">
        <nav aria-label="Rooms">
          {rooms.map((room) => (
            <p key={room}>
              <a href={`#${room.toLowerCase().replace(' ', '-')}`} onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
                {room}
              </a>
            </p>
          ))}
        </nav>
      </Drawer>
    </>
  );
}
```
